description: This file defines the Order model class within the Opencart admin module, specifically handling the retrieval of individual orders and lists of orders from the database, including filtering, sorting, and formatting order data.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Model class for order-related database operations within the OpenCart admin module. It provides methods to fetch single orders and lists of orders with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific order identified by order ID, including customer info, address details, order status, and associated data.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches a list of orders based on provided filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters. Returns structured order data with decoded custom fields and related info.

methods.name: getOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns all orders associated with a given subscription ID by querying the database.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the total count of orders associated with a specific subscription ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves products related to a specific order ID.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByProductId
methods.description: Calculates the total quantity ordered for a specific product ID.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Fetches options linked to a specific order and order product ID.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves subscription information for a given order and order product ID.

methods.name: getVouchers
methods.description: Fetches vouchers associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getVoucherByVoucherId
methods.description: Retrieves a voucher's details based on voucher ID.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Returns various totals related to an order, possibly filtered by criteria.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Counts total orders, optionally filtered by various criteria such as status, store, customer, dates, and more.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Returns the count of orders with a specific status ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByProcessingStatus
methods.description: Calculates total number of orders with a processing status defined in configuration.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCompleteStatus
methods.description: Calculates total number of orders with a completion status defined in configuration.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByStoreId
methods.description: Returns total orders for a specific store ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Returns total orders with a particular order status ID.

methods.name: getTotalSales
methods.description: Calculates total sales amount based on order data and optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByLanguageId
methods.description: Returns count of orders for a specific language ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCurrencyId
methods.description: Returns count of orders for a specific currency ID.

methods.name: createInvoiceNo
methods.description: Generates a new invoice number for a specified order ID, incrementing the maximum existing invoice number, or starting at 1 if none exists.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total reward points for a given order ID by summing reward points from order products.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of history entries (status changes, comments, notifications) associated with an order, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total count of history entries for a given order.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Returns the total count of history entries for a specific order status ID.

methods.name: getEmailsByProductsOrdered
methods.description: Fetches distinct email addresses associated with orders containing specified products, with support for pagination.

methods.name: getTotalEmailsByProductsOrdered
methods.description: Returns the total number of distinct email addresses for orders containing specified products.

search-terms: filter orders by date and total
